updates_v2: Moved to Fractal² with new ways in: start by where you are, filter all 153 patterns, read any pattern in two minutes, and a page for every tactic.
updates_v1: First edition of this sector online: 335 tactics across eight stages, 153 patterns in ten families, and the ten that matter most.
method_lede: A map of how manipulation and control work in one industry, written to help people recognise a pattern and respond safely.
method_is_h: What this is, and what it is not
method_is: It describes recurring situations: the tactics people meet, the order they tend to come in, the signs you can see, what to keep and where to get help.
method_isnot: It is not a verdict about any person or company, not legal advice and not therapy. A pattern describes a situation, not a person, and intent always needs more evidence than a match.
method_how: Each of the {tactics} tactics has a short definition and three examples: in a person's life, inside an organization, and in the wider culture. Each of the {patterns} patterns is a sequence of tactics written as a scene, then taken apart: why the order matters, what you might notice, ordinary explanations to rule out, what to keep, what breaks the chain, when to get help and words you could use. The examples are composites built from common situations.
method_labels: Labels in the text show what kind of statement a sentence is and where checking stands. The counts below are across every pattern in this sector.
method_std: Six standards apply to every pattern in this sector. Each pattern page points back to them.
method_licence: The text is the author's work. Ask before reusing it beyond quotation with a link. The typefaces are Newsreader and Hanken Grotesk, both under the SIL Open Font License.
method_contact: If something here is wrong, out of date or unclear, tell Noble Father Creations through noblefathercreations.com. Corrections are listed under Updates on the sector home.
take_lede: Every pattern page prints as a clean hand-out, black on white, with the quick-read sections first.
take_print: Printing works from any pattern page. The page drops the menus and puts the safety note, what it is, the tactics, the tests, what breaks the chain, when to get help and the words you could use on the first pages. The rest of the pattern follows.
take_step2: Use your browser's Print command, or save as PDF from the print dialog.
take_step3: The printed copy carries the page address and the date it was updated, so it can be matched to this site later.
take_pdf_soon: PDF editions of the sector are being prepared. Until then, print any pattern from its page.
take_labels_note: Printed copies carry the same labels as the site. This page was updated on {date}.
take_share: Every pattern has a two-minute version. Add #quick to the end of a pattern's address, or use its 2-minute read link, to send just the parts someone needs first.

nt_step3: Patterns that share what you ticked
nt_caveat: These are places to start reading. A match is not proof of anything, and it says nothing about anyone's intent. Every pattern has a section called "Before you read too much into it". Read that too.
nt_pick: Pick an area or type a word to see signs.
inn_stages_d2: Open the stage that sounds most like now. You will see what tends to come next and the patterns that live there.
inn_after_replace: This is the last stage. The cycle often begins again with someone new, or with you, at the first stage.
inn_live_here: Patterns that pass through this stage
worried_see_h: What you might see from outside
worried_see_d: Three signs from each pattern, in its own words. Open an area that fits their work. A sign is a reason to pay attention, never proof.
worried_do_1: Stay in contact, and keep it ordinary. Isolation is how most of these patterns hold.
worried_do_2: Ask what they have noticed before telling them what you see.
worried_do_3: Do not confront the other person or organization yourself. If anyone is in danger, contact emergency services; if a child is involved, child protection.
sign_note: Two tests and one phrase from each pattern, in the pattern's own words. Law and contracts vary by place: have an independent adviser read anything before you sign it.
map_lede2: Every tactic sits on the ring, grouped into the eight stages. Every pattern sits inside. Pick a pattern and its sequence is drawn in order. Pick a tactic and every pattern that uses it lights up.
map_desc: A ring of {t} points, one for each tactic, in eight groups for the eight stages. Inside the ring are {c} points, one for each pattern, in ten groups for the ten families. The tables below give the same information as text.
map_caption: Tap or click a point, or use the two lists. Arrow keys step along a chosen sequence.
